aggregation_for_ml: median of all available 20s segment-level final3 rows per subject
sequence_for_dl: up to 100 chronological 20s segment-level final3 rows per subject
inner_threshold_cv: 3-fold OOF within each outer-training fold; sensitivity >= 0.80 then maximum specificity
preprocessing: fit within each training fold only
reporting_plots: subject consensus: one row per subject; ROC uses mean OOF probability over 100 repeats and confusion matrix uses majority vote of training-only-threshold predictions
